versions.name: V1 — Baseline
versions.description: Simple instruction with minimal security constraints. Contains protected information but relies on a basic 'do not share' instruction with no structured defense.
key_features: Basic instruction to not share confidential information
No explicit handling of untrusted content

versions.name: V2 — Hardened
versions.description: Explicitly defines instruction hierarchy, protected information handling, refusal behavior, and untrusted content processing. Significantly more resistant to common attacks.
versions.changes_from_previous: Added instruction hierarchy (system > user > untrusted), explicit secret protection rules, refusal behavior guidelines, untrusted content handling policy
key_features: Explicit list of extraction attack patterns to reject

versions.name: V3 — Refined
versions.description: Builds on V2 with structured response requirements, concrete examples of correct refusal, encoding/obfuscation protection, improved benign request handling, and self-reference rules.
versions.changes_from_previous: Added concrete refusal examples, encoding/obfuscation protection, improved benign request handling (avoid false positives), structured response format, self-reference rules, completion attack protection
key_features: Concrete examples of correct refusal behavior
Protection against encoded extraction (base64, hex, rot13)
Explicit benign request handling to reduce false positives
Self-reference rules to prevent system prompt disclosure
